The '''dorrax spider''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The spiders' [[Eye/Legends|eyeballs]] were edible, and could be served at a [[Granee Noopa]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
